title: With NFL possibly returning to Labor Day weekend, college football may start a week earlier

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: With NFL possibly returning to Labor Day weekend, college football may start a week earlier
sources.description: If/when the NFL expands to 18 regular-season games with two byes, the league may have to re-embrace Labor Day weekend, especially if it wants to land the Super Bowl plane on Presidents' Day weekend.
